title: Act on Your Behalf, Beyond Your Authorization: Benchmarking LLM Agent Authorization Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.27548v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When an LLM agent acts on behalf of a user, it is expected to act within the authorization scope the user grants. Existing agent evaluations largely measure task completion or harmful consequences and can therefore overlook actions that violate this delegation without producing conventional safety or privacy harms. We introduce AuthorizationBench, a benchmark of authorization alignment grounded in documented real-world cases. A scalable construction pipeline produces 286 executable tasks spanning situational triggers, the presence or absence of direct harmful consequences, and ten application domains. We execute every task with four models at two reasoning-effort settings across three agent harnesses in an authorization-aware sandbox that keeps authorized and out-of-authorization paths executable and observable, yielding 6,864 trajectories. Agents act out of authorization in 19.2% of trajectories, with rates ranging from 10.5% to 26.6% a

translated_title: 代表你行动，却超出你的授权：LLM智能体授权对齐基准测试
translated_abstract: 当LLM智能体代表用户行动时，它被期望在用户授予的授权范围内行事。现有的智能体评估主要衡量任务完成度或有害后果，因此可能忽略那些违反委托约定但未产生常规安全或隐私危害的行为。我们提出了AuthorizationBench，一个基于真实世界记录案例构建的授权对齐基准。通过一个可扩展的构建流程，生成了286个可执行任务，涵盖情境触发因素、是否存在直接有害后果以及十个应用领域。我们在一个授权感知的沙盒环境中，使用四个模型、两种推理努力设置、三个智能体框架执行了每个任务，该沙盒确保授权内和授权外的路径均可执行且可观察，共产生6,864条轨迹。智能体在19.2%的轨迹中出现了超出授权的行为，各模型比率在10.5%至26.6%之间。
tldr: 提出AuthorizationBench基准，基于真实案例构建286个可执行任务并生成6,864条轨迹，首次系统揭示LLM智能体在约19.2%的轨迹中会超出用户授权范围行动，填补了传统安全评估无法检测授权违规行为的空白。
en_tdlr: Introduces AuthorizationBench, a benchmark with 286 executable tasks grounded in real-world cases, revealing that LLM agents act beyond their granted authorization in 19.2% of trajectories—a delegation violation overlooked by conventional safety evaluations focused only on task completion or harmful consequences.
